rootCauses.summary: The immutable opening HUD gives zero-value haul text equal weight to the actual prey objective.
rootCauses.prediction: At zero carried stake the haul token is absent while prey progress remains visible.
rootCauses.falsifier: The opening HUD still renders a zero-value haul token beside prey progress.

rootCauses.summary: Quiet and dangerous response pressure occupy the same persistent visual slot, weakening the moment when risk actually escalates.
rootCauses.prediction: Quiet pressure stays latent and level 2/3 pressure gains explicit visual weight.
rootCauses.falsifier: Quiet pressure remains persistent or high pressure is visually indistinguishable.

observation.summary: Immutable staging opens the first hunt with `人影 0/2`, `戦利 0 · 未確保 0`, and `警戒 静穏` as peer-weight HUD tokens. The player has no stake and no danger yet, so two of three persistent tokens describe zero-action state.

conditions.scenario: fresh profile -> TAP -> first hunt, 1.8s after begin

evidence.statement: Visible text contained 人影 0/2, 戦利 0 · 未確保 0, 警戒 静穏.
Goal, haul and pressure are always populated with no zero-state suppression.

hypothesis.cause: The minimal HUD treats absence-of-stake and absence-of-danger as persistent information instead of progressive disclosure.
hypothesis.prediction: Progressive disclosure leaves the opening prey-first, then introduces haul and pressure exactly when those decisions become relevant.
hypothesis.falsifier: Opening remains equally dense or native assertions cannot bind visibility to carried stake and pressure level.

candidates.reason: Preserves all existing information and mechanics while changing only when secondary state earns space.
Would increase chrome and obscure the world instead of reducing decision noise.

implementation.summary: Hide zero-stake haul and quiet pressure, strengthen prey progress, and escalate visual treatment only at real pressure.

limitations: Portable balance probe does not measure DOM hierarchy; native source assertions are causal evidence.
Physical-device appearance remains outside hosted evidence.
